What do you think you're doing?''"<br />"''Put the Mask down and step away from the crypt!|Veela Ordo orders Revan to put down Mandalore's Mask while Canderous Ordo questions Veela's intentions|<ref name="TOR:R" />}}
A '''skirmish''' took place in [[3954 BBY]] inside [[Dramath the Second's tomb]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rekkiad]]. [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]], accompanied by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Canderous Ordo]], had been led to the tomb by Revan's memories&mdash;of him previously discovering the tomb&mdash;revealing the location of the [[Mandalore's Mask|Mask]] of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]]. While in the tomb, Canderous's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], [[Veela Ordo|Veela]], and five other Mandalorians ambushed Revan and Canderous, confronting them on Revan's identity and how Veela believed that her husband should lead [[Clan Ordo]]. When Canderous refused to join Veela, they engaged in a [[Lightfight|firefight]] that ended with the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of Veela and the five Mandalorians with her. The [[Standard day/Legends|day]] after the skirmish, Revan told Canderous the truth about how the [[Mandalorian Wars]] really began, and how the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|hidden Sith Empire]] was behind the invasion of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Who are you to talk of betrayal? You turned your back on your people. And for what? To throw your lot in with Revan the Butcher?|Veela Ordo tells Canderous Ordo of his betrayal of Clan Ordo|<ref name="TOR:R" />}}
[[File:MandaloreTheUltimateWithWickedGoldFlames-KOTOR15.jpg|thumb|right|130px|Mandalore's Mask]]
In [[3954 BBY]],<ref name="TERC" /> those clans of the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] warrior culture that had survived the [[Mandalorian Wars]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]&mdash;a conflict that had ended with the [[Death/Legends|death]] of their leader, [[Mandalore the Ultimate]], at the hands of the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan]]&mdash;gathered on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Rekkiad]] in order to [[Search for Mandalore's Mask|search]] for [[Mandalore's Mask]], the symbolic ceremonial war mask of the [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]]. That same [[Standard year/Legends|year]], Revan, now a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]], traveled to Rekkiad with the Mandalorian [[Canderous Ordo]] and helped [[Clan Ordo]], Canderous's clan, to locate the Mask. Revan and his friend [[Darth Malak|Malak]] had, [[3960 BBY|six years earlier]], previously hid the Mask in the [[Dramath the Second's tomb|tomb]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Dramath]], which was located in [[First Spear|one]] of the two [[Water/Legends|ice]] pillars known as the [[Twin Spears]] on Rekkiad's surface. Revan, operating under the alias "Avner," and Canderous joined Clan Ordo in its search, and Revan's memories led him to convince clan [[Chief/Legends|chief]] [[Veela Ordo]], Canderous's [[Marriage/Legends|wife]], to move their camp closer to the Twin Spears. However, the Twin Spears sat within the territory of [[Clan Jendri]], as each clan had chosen its own territory in which to search for the Mask.<ref name="TOR:R" />

The morning after Clan Ordo set up camp, it was [[Skirmish on Rekkiad|attacked]] by Clan Jendri in retaliation for its trespassing, and Clan Ordo emerged victorious with the aid of Revan&mdash;though he inadvertently revealed to Veela that he was a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the process. Clan Ordo celebrated its victory late into the night and the following [[Standard day/Legends|day]] arrived at its destination. The clan broke into two teams&mdash;the first consisting of Revan, Canderous, and two pilots, while the second consisted of Veela and three pilots&mdash;before climbing the First Spear. During the seven-[[Standard hour/Legends|hour]] climb, a member of Veela's team lost his footing and forced her team to retrieve him, slowing them down enough to allow Revan's team to reach the summit first. Revan led Clan Ordo to locate the entrance to the tomb atop the Spear. He and Canderous entered the tomb first and managed to find the Mask inside Dramath's [[Dramath the Second's sarcophagus|sarcophagus]].<ref name="TOR:R" />

==The skirmish==
{{Quote|We're not here to kill you. Just him.|Veela Ordo tells Canderous of her true intentions to kill Revan|<ref name="TOR:R" />}}
[[File:Revan_Headshot.png|thumb|left|130px|Jedi Master Revan]]
After Revan and Canderous opened Dramath's sarcophagus and found Mandalore's Mask, they were ambushed by Canderous's [[Gender/Legends|wife]] and the five pilots. Veela revealed that she knew Revan's Jedi identity and pleaded to Canderous that he break his loyalty to Revan and reclaim his place in Clan Ordo as their leader, stating that his rightful place was at her side. Canderous responded that he could not break his loyalty to Revan and pleaded to Veela and the others to stand down. With neither side backing down, Veela and her Mandalorians [[Lightfight|opened fire]] on Revan and Canderous, and the two were forced to fight for their lives.<ref name="TOR:R" />

Revan used his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to [[Form III/Legends|block and redirect]] the first volley of [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] shots back into the original two shooters and clipped Veela's shoulder with one shot. Veela and the surviving two Mandalorians took shelter and threw three [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] into the room, though Revan [[Telekinesis/Legends|lifted]] the sarcophagus lid and positioned it as a barrier to protect Canderous and himself. The blast shattered the lid to pieces and stunned Revan, prompting Veela and the remaining Mandalorians to rush into the room and try to kill Revan while he was disoriented. However, Canderous shot Veela before she could kill Revan. The remaining [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] were stunned by Veela's death, and Revan seized the opportunity by using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|throw]] his lightsaber at the distracted soldiers, killing them before they could move to safety.<ref name="TOR:R" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|About two years before he declared war on the Republic, Mandalore was approached by a man with skin the color of blood&mdash;a Sith. [&hellip;] But this red-skinned being came to Mandalore. He claimed to be the emissary of a powerful Master&mdash;a descendant of the Sith Lord who had driven Dramath into exile&mdash;and convinced Mandalore to help him search for his enemy's tomb.|Revan tells Canderous Ordo of the Sith emissary who asked Mandalore The Ultimate's help in his mission|<ref name="TOR:R" />}}
[[File:CanderousHS-KOTOR.jpg|thumb|right|130px|Future Mandalore Canderous Ordo]]
The following day Revan told Canderous the truth about how the Mandalorian Wars began. He spoke of an [[Unidentified Sith emissary|emissary]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|hidden Sith Empire]] who traveled to [[Mandalore/Legends|Mandalore]]&mdash;the Mandalorian [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]]&mdash;to seek help from the current Mandalore, Mandalore the Ultimate, in [[Search for Dramath the Second's remains|locating]] the [[Skeleton/Legends|remains]] of [[Dramath the Second]], the enemy of the emissary's [[Sith Master/Legends|Master]], the [[Tenebrae|Sith Emperor]]. The emissary and Mandalore discovered Dramath's tomb on the planet Rekkiad, and the emissary took the remains to give back to his Master. The emissary told Mandalore of a [[Force vision/Legends|vision]] his Master had of the Mandalorian warriors rising up and defeating the Republic, while casting a [[Qâzoi Kyantuska|spell]] that only affected Mandalore the Ultimate, to ensure the Mandalorian invasion.<ref name="TOR:R" />

After telling Canderous the truth, Revan asked him to stay behind and become the new Mandalore&mdash;to protect his people and the Republic. After listening to Revan, Canderous donned Mandalore's Mask and proclaimed himself Mandalore the Preserver, vowing to help restore the glory and honor of his people. Revan then traveled to [[Nathema]], the planet recorded in [[Dramath the Second's datacron|Dramath's datacron]], to find more answers about the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]].<ref name="TOR:R" />

==Behind the scenes==
The skirmish first appeared within [[Drew Karpyshyn]]'s [[2011]] novel ''[[The Old Republic: Revan]]''.<ref name="TOR:R" />
